_comment: Labels for issue triage (ADR-0048). The triage workflow creates any that are missing; it never edits or deletes an existing label. Descriptions stay within GitHub's 100-character limit. Owners map an area to the GitHub login assigned when an issue has no assignee; "*" is the fallback.

sev:critical.description: Acknowledged write lost, torn write visible, chunk unrecoverable, data or key leak, auth bypass

sev:major.description: Safety check off or bypassable, crash, silent repair failure, spec divergence (ADR-0048)

sev:minor.description: Wrong behaviour with a workaround, regression, or misleading telemetry (ADR-0048)

sev:trivial.description: Cosmetic, wording, docs, or a test-only gap (ADR-0048)

reach:common.description: Normal operation with a default or documented configuration triggers it (ADR-0048)

reach:edge.description: Needs an unusual configuration, workload, fault combination or timing (ADR-0048)

reach:adversarial.description: Only when someone sets it up: hostile client or tenant, crafted input, compromised node

area:metadata.description: Metadata store, the commit point, and its backends (architecture 5.1)

area:client.description: Client: erasure coding, commit, reconstruct on read (architecture 5.1)

area:dserver.description: D servers and the ChunkStore seam (architecture 5.1)

area:coordination.description: Coordination: discovery, leases, leader election, fencing (L5)

area:gateway.description: Access layer and the S3 gateway (L1)

area:chunk-format.description: On-disk chunk format and its spec

area:security.description: Identity, mTLS, CA, KMS and access control (architecture 14)

area:testkit.description: Simulation testing and the conformance suites (ADR-0009)

priority:P0.description: Drop other work, fix now, block the release (ADR-0048)

priority:P2.description: Next milestone, or whenever it fits (ADR-0048)

needs-triage.description: Severity or reach could not be placed; see the triage comment (ADR-0048)
